name: RB World 4
desc:
- ⭐️ MyPlayer is now FREE!
Welcome to RB World 4, a semi-realistic basketball simulation!

- 🏀 Play with friends in "Play Now" with preset teams!
- 🏀 Use preset players in 4v4 Blacktop!
- 🏀 Create your own player in "My Player"!
- 🏀 Play competitively against other players in Park & Rec. Center!
- 🏀 Customize your very own personal gym!
- 🏀 Start or join a league!

- ⭐️ Some cosmetics and clothing items are exclusive to Premium players!
